Name: Billboard Beautifier
Author: Taskmaster2
Description:
[b]Billboard Beautifier
[/b]
Give your Stardew Valley calendar a seasonal makeover! This mod decorates the in-game calendar (billboard) frame with pixel art accents for spring, summer, fall, and winter — including a nice variety of seasonal flair such as flowers, drinks, icicles, and more. Forget the bland view of the past... lean into the future!  The static images of version 1.0 have been replaced with dynamically created decorations.

Help Wanted is now included, for Fishing, Gather Resources and Slay Monster quests.  Item Delivery will be in a future release.  Multiple layouts and cool surprises await!

Mod works for any language installed, does not impact the save, and can be effortless removed at any time.  Enjoy!

Manifest.Name: Billboard Beautifier
Manifest.Description: Enhances the calendar from plain to picturesque — one month at a time.
Manifest.Author: Taskmaster
